Dear Sir/Madam, 
 
Pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Part A of Schedule III of the Securities and Exchange Board 
of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 (‘Listing 
Regulations, 2015’), we inform you that the audio recording of the Earnings Conference Call with 
the Analysts/Investors held on Thursday, July 30, 2026 has been made available on the Company’s 
website. 
 
The recording can be accessed from the link:  
https://www.electronicsbazaar.com/pub/media/investor/i/Q1FY27_Earnings_Call_Recording.mp
3 
 
We request you to kindly take the above on records.
